product_metadata.title: 16 Counts Slow Cooker Liners Small Size(11 x 16 Inch) Kitchen Disposable Cooking Bags Fits 1 to 3 Quarts Safe for Oval or Round Pot (16)
features: Fits Slow Cookers: Cook food to perfection! Plastic liner bags fit in your slow cooker and prevent meats, fish, and other food from sticking. These inserts are disposable and can be tossed in the trash when done.
Package Contains : This package contains 16 small size slow cooker liners,16 x 11 inches, Fit 1QT to 3QT Slow Cooker, Pans,and Aluminum Cooking Trays.

Food Safe : BPA-Free slow cooker liner. Safe for high, medium, and low settings temps. Suitable for oven roasting, microwaving, re-heating, bowling, freezing, storing meats, snacks, pizzas, nuggets, and vegetables without the mess.

Durable and Convenient : Use our slow cooker liners to cook any food you like, include chicken, fish, soup, dessert and stew. Throw it directly into the trash after using. Shorten your cleaning time, keep the pot clean and extend the service life of the cookware.

Precautions : Our slow cooker liners is a one-time use product, please be careful not to be cut by sharp objects before use to avoid leakage. You can also use two slow cooker liners at one time to make your meal more enjoyable
description: Small Slow cooker Liner Bag- Fits 1 - 3 Quart , Clear Multi-Use Cooking Slow Cooker Liners, Used in Food Preparation, Cooking and Holding.
Perfect for your roast or chicken or stew.
